# `.github/workflows/`

- **Purpose:** GitHub Actions workflows (logic lives in `./x`).

| Workflow | Job | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `registers.yml` | `svd` | Python 3.13 with the packages of `tools/requirements.txt`, `xmllint` and the pinned svdtools (`toolchain` action, target `svdtools`), then `./x svd check`, `tests/host/svd/run.sh` and `tests/host/x/run.sh`. Keeps the merged SVD as the artifact `svd`. |
| | `pac` (after `svd`) | Takes the artifact `svd` instead of merging again. The pinned GNAT, gprbuild, alr, svdtools and svd2ada (target `pac`, which skips gnatprove and adalang_analyzer), then `./x pac check` (saves the package in the cache that `analyze` restores; regenerates the package, which is not committed, compares its hash with `libs/mpfs_pac/MPFS_Registers.sha256` and compiles it) and `tests/host/pac/run.sh`. |
| `images.yml` | `build` | The pinned compilers (target `gnat`). `./x test examples` and `./x metrics verify` against `metrics.golden` build every image once, then `./x test negative`, the runtime packs: `build/rts/packs` is cached under a key of `crates/mpfs_rts/packs.sha256`, `make_packs.sh` and `crates/bb-runtimes` (the packs are not committed, only their hashes), `make_packs.sh --ensure` fills what the cache lacks, `make_packs.sh --check` regenerates all six and compares the SHA-256 of their tar streams with `packs.sha256` (never taken from the cache), `crates/mpfs_rts/compare_toolchain.sh` (their common GNAT and GNARL sources equal the runtimes of the pinned toolchain) and the host suites that need no svdtools (`bare`, `report`, `negative`, `qemu_tests`, `stack`, `hw`, `analyze`, `prove` with its stand-in cases, `repro`, `rts_packs`, `rts_variants`, `rts_boot`, `rts_plic`, `rts_context`). `./x test examples` also builds `tasking_test`, `interrupt_test`, `trap_test` and `fp_context_test`, which build the runtime variants `light-tasking-e51-cpus1-m`, `light-tasking-u54-cpus1-m`, `light-e51-cpus1-m` and `light-u54-cpus1-m` first (their packs comes from the cache step, which therefore runs before the images are built). Artifacts (`if: always()`, 14 days): `images` (the packed `examples/*/bin-*`, after the metrics step, so every hart of `BUILD_HARTS`) and `metrics-measured` (the rows `./x metrics verify` measured, written to `MEASURED` in the format of `metrics.golden`: the rows to add for a compiler without a baseline). |
| | `qemu` (after `build`) | Ubuntu 26.04 with QEMU from apt. `./x test qemu` on the images of `build`: the smoke test and the `Test_Report` applications of `tests/qemu/tests.list`. Needs no toolchain and builds nothing (`MPFS_PREBUILT_IMAGES=1`). Keeps the output as the artifact `qemu-log`. |
| | `renode` (after `build`) | The pinned Renode release with its SHA-256. `./x test renode` on the images of `build`. Needs no toolchain and builds nothing. Keeps the output as the artifact `renode-log`. Not required for a merge. |
| | `repro` | The register package as in `build` (the two copies of the tree take it along), the pinned compilers (target `gnat`). `./x repro`: every image built twice in two directories with the same `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH`; the SHA-256 of the ELFs must be equal. After a failure the two copies and the build logs are the artifact `repro-builds`. Not in `build`, because it builds each image twice. |
| `quality.yml` | `prove` | The pinned compilers and the pinned gnatprove (target `gnatprove`), `./x prove`, and `tests/host/prove/run.sh` with the real gnatprove. |
| `hygiene.yml` | `reuse` | `reuse lint` and `tools/headers.py check`. Needs no toolchain. |
| | `trace` | `tools/trace.py --check` (every `@req` and `@verifies` reference resolves, every TSF requirement has a test, the committed `docs/assurance/trace-matrix.md` is current) and `tests/host/trace/run.sh`. Needs no toolchain. |
| | `docs` | `tools/check_docs.py`, i.e. `./x docs`: every relative link and `#anchor` of the Markdown files resolves; and `tests/host/docs/run.sh`. Python only, needs no toolchain. |
| `analyze.yml` | `analyze` | The register package (the composite action `.github/actions/pac`: a cache keyed by the recorded hash `libs/mpfs_pac/MPFS_Registers.sha256`; on a miss it installs `xmllint` and the `pac` target and generates the package, on a hit it installs nothing), the pinned adalang_analyzer (target `adalang_analyzer`), `./x analyze` and `./x analyze --style` against the baselines. Runs only when `tools/analyzer-baselines/*.baseline` exist, because a project without a baseline fails by design. |
| | `baseline` | Only when the workflow is run by hand with "Write the baselines": `./x analyze --update-baseline` (both rule sets), uploads `tools/analyzer-baselines/` as the artifact `analyzer-baselines`, to be committed. |

| Workflow | Runs on |
|---|---|
| `registers.yml` | a push to any branch and a pull request against `main` that touch the SVD, the PAC, their tools, the host tests or the actions |
| `images.yml` | a push to any branch and a pull request against `main` that touch the examples, `crates/bb-runtimes`, `crates/mpfs_rts`, `hw/`, the tests, the tools, `metrics.golden`, `x` or the actions |
| `quality.yml` | a push to any branch and a pull request against `main` that touch the proof projects, `tools/prove.*`, the pins, `libs/`, `x` or the actions |
| `hygiene.yml` | every push to any branch and every pull request against `main` |
| `analyze.yml` | a push to any branch and a pull request against `main` that touch `libs/` (which includes the recorded hash of the register package), the examples, the analyzer files, the baselines, the pins or `x`; by hand for the baselines |

The workflows stay separate on purpose: each installs only what it needs (the `svd` job and `hygiene` no Ada toolchain, `pac` and `images` the compilers, `quality` and `analyze` the proof and analysis tools; the `toolchain` action caches them) and runs only for the paths it depends on, so a change to a README does not start a gnatprove build. All logic is in `./x` and the tools, so a workflow only installs, caches and calls; moving to a runner of our own means changing the `runs-on` lines. A push to any branch starts the workflows whose paths it touches and a pull request against `main` runs them again as a pull request, on the merge result (a pull request against another branch shows the checks of its head commit); a newer push to the same branch cancels the run in progress. A path filter means a workflow does not report for a change outside its paths, so a status must not be required for merging unless the workflow has no filter (`hygiene.yml`).

The composite action `.github/actions/toolchain` restores the cached tools and runs `./x toolchain install <target>` (the cache key follows `tools/toolchain.env`; a target that needs the compilers and has no cache of its own starts from the cache of the compilers). Every workflow uses it instead of repeating the cache and install steps, and a job that needs the result of an earlier job takes it as an artifact.

Actions are pinned by version tag (`actions/checkout`, `actions/setup-python`, `actions/cache`, `actions/upload-artifact`, `actions/download-artifact`). Dependabot (`.github/dependabot.yml`) proposes the updates once a week, in one pull request for all actions, and only for versions that are at least 14 days old. Review that pull request for the Node.js runtime of the new versions (Node.js 24 or later) before merging.
